page.layout: One column of text, with a centred word "AMEN." below it; then a centred chapter heading "CONCIO XIX." with "Iudic. 3." beneath; then a paragraph opening with a large woodcut initial H. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Quarto, quia proximo est iniuriosa, 2.Reg. 11. 12. Denique ipsi scortatori nociua. Aufert enim ei cor, sicut & ebrietas, Hose.4. priuat eum opibus, Prou. 29. Luc. 15. Eccles. 9. honore, Leuit. 21.1. Cor. 5. vita, Num. 25. Deut. 22.2. Reg. 13. regno Dei, Gal. 5. Apoc. 21.

Hæc cūm omnes, tum præcipuè iuuenes diligenter considerare debent, ut cogitatione magnitudinis peccati, & grauitatis supplicij affuefcant turpes motus cordis compescere. Deus pater noster cœlestis creet in nobis corda munda, & abluat, sanctificet, iustificet nos per nomen Domini Iesu, & per spiritum suum sanctum, ut eum in corpore nostro, & in spiritu nostro glorificare possi-mus, nunc, & semper, & in secula seculorum, AMEN.
main_text.head: CONCIO XIX. Judic. 3.
main_text.p: HAbitauerunt autem filii Israel inter Chananæum, Hittheum, Aemoræum, Pherizæum, Huæum & Jebusæum. Duxeruntq; filias eorum sibi in uxores, & filias suas dederunt filiis eorum, seruieruntq; diis eorum. Et fecerunt filii Israel malum in oculis Domini, obliitque sunt Domini Dei sui, colentes Bealim & Aferoth.

page.notes: Woodcut initial H read as "H" joined to "Abitauerunt". "Aemoræum" [?] and "Aferoth" [?] are doubtful: the scan is worn. "oblitique" in the print has an accent over the final vowel; read as "obliitque" [?]. The heading "Iudic. 3." is set as part of the chapter heading. The first paragraph continues from the previous page (cont="true").
